details.description: KAT-Dev (published on Hugging Face as Kwaipilot/KAT-Dev) is a 33-billion-parameter open-weight coding model from Kwaipilot, Kuaishou's AI team, built on Qwen3-32B through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement-learning stages for software-engineering tasks. Kwaipilot released it as the open-source counterpart to its proprietary KAT-Coder model, incorporating teacher trajectories annotated by human engineers during training. It is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
advantages: Resolves 62.4% of tasks on SWE-bench Verified, ranking 5th among open-source models at the time of Kwaipilot's report.
Trained with teacher trajectories annotated by human engineers, which Kwaipilot says improves training stability.
Uses multi-level prefix caching and entropy-based trajectory pruning for efficient large-scale reinforcement learning, per Kwaipilot.
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, permitting broad reuse.
disadvantages: Kwaipilot notes that extensive mid-training for tool use showed limited direct performance gains on current leaderboards for this model.
use_cases: Code generation and completion for software-engineering tasks

notes: The Hugging Face repository is named "Kwaipilot/KAT-Dev" (no size suffix); the catalog's slug/canonical "kat-dev-32b" refers to this same 33B model, served via Fireworks under that id. The model card text I could read did not state an explicit context-window figure, so the catalog's facts (131072) are kept without a comparable source figure.
